programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Life in Camel Town
programme.desc: When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious?figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Ad Break

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter MOVNING! MOVNING is known for his trademark, consoling piano sounds that match beautifully with his calm vocals. He debuted in 2016 with the single “Life is a Rainbow” and then made himself known to the public in 2018 through the song “Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry.” The 2018 release also earned him the nicknames of “an artist that every listener should listen to” and “an artist that deserves to top all the music charts.” In June this year, MOVNING made its much-anticipated comeback with the song “Your Name, Youth.” With magnificent string sounds, this new release beautifully portrays “youth,” an age of uncertainty and turmoil, yet possibly the most precious thing in life. In this episode, MOVNING performs “Life is a Rainbow,” “Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry,” “Twilight of Youth,” “Your Name, Youth,” and more to nourish our souls. Tune in to I’m LIVE and feel the ultimate beauty of youth once again with MOVNING!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is a band ready to touch our heart - TOUCHED! TOUCHED is comprised of vocalist and guitarist Yunmin, drummer Kim Seung-bin, bassist John B. Kim, guitarist D.on, and keyboardist Chae Do-hyeon. With their intense sounds and wide spectrum of music, the quintet has been praised for opening a new era in the band music scene. They are also the first band to have won the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest and have taken home top prizes from many other music contests, mesmerizing both critics and general listeners. TOUCHED is back on I’m LIVE 2 years after their first appearance and performs “Hi Bully,” “Alive,” “Shut Down,” “Love is Dangerous,” and more to show off their flawless musicality. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet TOUCHED!

TOUCHED is comprised of vocalist and guitarist Yunmin, drummer Kim Seung-bin, bassist John B. Kim, guitarist D.on, and keyboardist Chae Do-hyeon. With their intense sounds and wide spectrum of music, the quintet has been praised for opening a new era in the band music scene. They are also the first band to have won the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest and have taken home top prizes from many other music contests, mesmerizing both critics and general listeners. TOUCHED is back on I’m LIVE 2 years after their first appearance and performs “Hi Bully,” “Alive,” “Shut Down,” “Love is Dangerous,” and more to show off their flawless musicality. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet TOUCHED!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for debtors x I’m LIVE by debtors
[5510] One-way love can still be true if you maintain the right speed and distance. Experience the thrill and heartbreak of one-sided love with this upbeat song. [Why Am I?] We see chairs everywhere we go,but some look so weak and fragile, making us wonder if it’s safe to sit on them. Please focus on the lyrics and enjoy the song to the fullest. [Barking Dogs] It’s not always pleasant to stay in a place where everything is fleeting. Please focus on the lyrics to enjoy the song to the fullest. [Mast] We sometimes have to offer the last cigarette in the pack. The song’s relaxed yet explosive sounds express that frustration. [Relativity] Many become more lenient when they get tipsy. When they get really drunk, however, they become more belligerent, especially if you are late. This song is about that funny switch.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Jeon Jin Hee x I’m LIVE by Jeon Jin Hee
[Should We Leave] This is the lead single from my third album. Anywhere works for me as long as we can be together. I wrote this song in hopes of overcoming the fear of everything disappearing. [Without Anyone Knowing] With only the acoustic guitar, this story somehow makes me feel sad. [Be Drunk] This new arrangement will excite you for sure! [A Trivial Story] This song features a blunt drumbeat and bass tone. The way the rhythm flows always makes me so happy. [ Unable to Speak That We Miss Each Other] Please enjoy the guitar riffs that evoke images of flickering lights at night.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for Dasutt x I’m LIVE by Dasutt
[Like a Sea] Let’s listen to the sea quietly. [Camel] Please enjoy the contrast between the melody and the lyrics. [I really hope I arrive safely] This song features a calm start and an explosive end. [Youth] This is our message to young adults who work relentlessly for their dreams. Let’s sing the song together!

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: we'll be seeing the best penguin fails, p-p-p-party penguins, we'll get up close and personal with wild animals, and we'll go on safari. we'll also meet angry animals living the thug life, some crazy critters, and we'll watch sporty animals in action.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.desc: A comprehensive news bulletin beginning with the latest developments from Malaysia, followed by key stories from around the globe. The program concludes with a concise roundup of international sports highlights.

programme.title: Malaysia Tonight
programme.desc: Malaysia Tonight is a live flagship news programme featuring comprehensive coverage of Malaysia’s top stories, alongside selected international news and sports segments for a broader perspective.

programme.title: On The Table (OTT)
programme.desc: 'On The Table' is a talk show that explores a range of topics, emphasizing Malaysia's current issues and trends. It also seeks to position Malaysia as an appealing investment and business hub for foreign investors, featuring insights from opinion leaders and influential figures.

programme.title: World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation news program, which brings together content material in the form of features and human interest from ASEAN countries and around the world.

programme.title: Global Voices
programme.desc: 'Global Voices' is a mixed-slot program featuring a blend of engaging content, including both previously aired shows and fresh new programs that resonate with a global audience. Focusing on current issues, culture, technology, and international harmony, Global Voices aims to connect viewers with a broader perspective of the world. The program also offers inspiring stories and discussions from diverse cultural backgrounds, bringing audiences closer to the realities of our increasingly interconnected global community.

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: 珈点不一样
programme.desc: 一杯音乐，一段旅程，速珈为你调配属于凌晨的独家节奏。早起跑步/运动小贴士，心灵治愈小故事，新歌/90年代/旧曲分享

programme.title: 早安 老时光
programme.desc: 每天 5点到6点，为您送上60-80 经典老歌，让你听出耳油！

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: Tech Me
programme.desc: A tech focused program with the latest updates on Tech news, Gaming and Gadgets. Every Monday at 12:15pm

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 爱上说故事

programme.title: 歌里寻他千百回
programme.desc: 人海茫茫，我们总在别人的歌声里，寻找着自己的影子。这里是《歌里寻他千百回》，一档用旋律解构心事、用歌词安放灵魂的声音空间。每一首经典的背后，都藏着一段未完的故事；每一段动人的旋律，都是一次久别重逢。夜色渐深，请戴上耳机，跟随我们的声音，在漫漫歌海中，寻觅那个曾让你怦然心动、或是泪流满面的“他”。

programme.title: Guns of Eden
programme.desc: During a camping trip deep in the mountains, former Buffalo cop Megan and her friends stumble upon the local sheriff unlawfully executing a drug trafficker. Spotted and marked for death, they find every escape route sealed. To cover up his crime, the sheriff summons an armed militia to hunt them down—triggering a deadly chase with no way out.

programme.title: 3AM - The Driver
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Creepy Pasta
programme.desc: Trapped in an abandoned house, a young man desperately searches for clues about his trapped situation. The unsettling truth actually lies in a sequence of viral videos and they gradually corrupt his mind…

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: Mary moves back to her suburban hometown as her husband is relocated there for work. While waiting for her husband in their new house, Mary becomes the target of an evil slasher that stalks the suburbs in an ice-cream truck. She soon learns that the suburbs are not what they seem...

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hell's Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qi's gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qi's husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.
